youtube.baslik: Do group programs work for people with hearing loss? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Active Communication Education, developed in Australia, is one of the best-known group programs and runs for five weeks with sessions of about two hours each week. In a randomized study, participants reported less activity limitation and participation restriction than the control group. The evidence for group programs is promising, but the number of studies and follow-up periods are still limited.
